records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fwhy-facts.md
records.summary: Seeds versions individual work-item facts in Quipu transactions rather than treating the board as a sequence of whole database snapshots.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fstorage-modes.md
records.summary: The same work-item model supports embedded storage, a repository-local pendant, a remote server and synchronization; conflicts are reported rather than silently choosing a side.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/seeds/src%2Fnative%2Fcli.rs
records.summary: The sd CLI provides beads-compatible work-item verbs and JSON contracts; native argument parsing selects storage without changing the wasm-clean core.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/seeds/src%2Fnative%2Fconfig.rs
records.summary: Storage configuration resolves explicit flags before environment, project configuration and user configuration. Conflicting or unreadable routing refuses rather than choosing a different store.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/seeds/src%2Fpendant.rs
records.summary: Seeds uses the Quipu share format for a ledger pendant: canonical exported facts, receiver shapes and manifests retain provenance and validate before loading.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/seeds/src%2Flib.rs
records.summary: The Rust library exposes the work-item model and backend abstraction independently of native process, file, clock and network integration.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fstorage.md
records.summary: One project is one named graph. A work item is a schema.org Action; public vocabulary and Quechua governance terms are preferred over tracker-specific terms.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fwhy-facts.md
records.summary: Read the fact-level storage rationale before changing tracker semantics or mapping another tool’s database surface.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Freference.md
records.summary: Read the sd global options, verbs, JSON and exit-code contracts before changing a caller-facing behavior.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/seeds/AGENTS.md
records.summary: Contributions preserve the wasm-clean core, documented storage semantics, public-safe source and full just check quality gate.
